seed_fact: Mention nearby landmarks on your contact page. Helps Google's local relevance signals.
caption:
Customers search for services near them every day. Add the name of a well‑known nearby landmark or street on your contact page – Google sees that you’re truly local and boosts your rankings. Want a site that attracts local traffic? DM me for a quick audit.
